items.title: Jack Henry (NASDAQ:JKHY) beats Q3 CY2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Financial technology provider Jack Henry & Associates (NASDAQ:JKHY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with revenue up 10.3% year on year to $701.5 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.71 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its GAAP profit of $2.28 per share was 10.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
